description: Weekly speculative positioning in futures: CFTC Commitments of Traders for US-listed FX, rates, equity-index, energy, metals, agricultural and bitcoin futures, and ESMA's MiFID II reports for Dutch TTF gas. Net position, % of open interest, week change, 52/156-week COT index, crowding, other trader groups, optional weekly history. Plain data, not a signal. No arguments lists every market's latest reading.

markets.description: Market keys, e.g. ["gold", "ust10", "eur", "wti", "ttf", "btc", "spx"]. Call without arguments for the full list.

terms.description: Whole-word match on market name or group, e.g. ["gold"], ["metals"], ["yen"].

weeks.description: Weekly history rows to add per market (default 0).

name: get_positioning
title: Get futures positioning (CFTC COT, ESMA)
